# GoodDayNight

> GoodDayNight is a gratitude journal that turns every good moment you save today into its own bedtime story tonight.

A daily gratitude journal and bedtime stories for adults in one ritual. During the day you save as many good moments as you like, as a text or a photo. Each moment becomes its own short bedtime story that you listen to that night, then it's gone. Tomorrow you look again.

## Who it's for
- Adults who want a daily gratitude journal habit without the blank page
- People looking for a simple mindfulness, self-care or reflection journal
- Adults who want a calming bedtime story to wind down with

## Why it works
In a well-known study (Seligman et al., 2005, American Psychologist), people who wrote down three good things each night for a week felt happier for up to six months afterwards. GoodDayNight builds on that habit.
